title: Zone contents
statement: For a natural number $\ell$, a zone configuration consists of a possibly absent Boolean home cell and two families of lists of possibly absent Boolean values, indexed by $i<\ell$. Each list in either family has length at most $2^{i+1}$.
hypotheses_covered: Left and right lists indexed by $i<\ell$
Each left and right list at index $i$ has length at most $2^{i+1}$
